name: Greenbox shared indexed palette
indexConvention: Array slot is the VOX palette index. Slot 0 is transparent air. UVs sample index minus one.
identityProtection: Restore original identity slots after choosing a preset; explicit manual overrides then take precedence. Shared eye ink/white slots also affect props.

island.label: Island
island.description: Warm cream, ocean teal, terracotta and leafy greens.

pastel.label: Pastel
pastel.description: Soft sage, dusty rose, lavender and pale wood.

neon.label: Neon
neon.description: Midnight surfaces, cyan light, vivid pink and gold accents.

mono.label: Monochrome
mono.description: Neutral luminance values preserve the original light and shadow hierarchy.

garden.label: Greenbox Garden
garden.description: Citrus lime foliage, turquoise, warm sand and soil, cream, sky blue and restrained raspberry accents. Original identity colors stay protected.
